card.name: Words after a negation or hedge
card.fires_on: The word right after a negation or hedge such as not, none or won't, where a contrast or qualification is about to follow. It fires on words like technically, ready, not, be, can and earned in general web prose.

modes.label: Hedge adverb after not
modes.description: An adverb or adjective that follows 'not' and qualifies a claim.
modes.example: These and many other plants not<< technically>> true bulbs have bulb-like organs that function

modes.label: Word after a negated verb
modes.description: A verb, 'not' or a connector right after a negative helper, setting up a contrast.
modes.example: Person B states that they do<< not>> really mind tile countertops and to them,

modes.label: Contrast turn
modes.description: A comma or 'and' that starts a 'but' or 'becomes' clause after a negative statement.
modes.example: Giving a doll-loving little girl a tool set probably won't turn her into a construction expert<<,>> but building a dollhouse together might be

card.writes: It slightly favors words like evidently and suppresses hardly and barely, so it pushes away more hedging words.
card.plain: It lights up on the word just after a 'not' or 'none' phrase, where the writer is about to qualify or contrast a claim.
